name: codex-architecture-governance
description: Evidence-backed architecture audits, verification, remediation planning, portfolio reviews, and deterministic quality gates for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Audit one repository, verify findings, plan remediation, review AI and mobile boundaries, govern a project portfolio, and enforce verified findings with deterministic policy. Local helpers require Python 3.11–3.13 with PyYAML and jsonschema.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository's architecture and verify every finding.
Plan remediation for the latest verified architecture review.
Evaluate the latest verified review against architecture policy.
